messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Employment, Vocational education and training, Higher and further education, Social conditions and indicators, and Family life and marriage in North Rhine-Westphalia during the 1980s, matching this research need: Longitudinal follow-up data on former high school students 15 years later, covering education-to-work transitions, college and vocational pathways, career histories, family formation, social origins, attitudes, political participation, and life satisfaction in Germany.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
